system.description:
You manifest a blade of chilling illusionary chakra to strike through a target’s senses, impeding them temporarily.

Make a melee Genjutsu attack again a creature you can see within range. On a hit, you deal 4d6 psychic damage and force them to make an Intelligence saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.

Success: Affected creature is Dazzled and lose access to special senses they may have until the end of the current turn.

Failure: Affected creatures’ senses are damaged. They gain 1 rank of Concussed and lose access to special senses they have until the end of their next turn (Ex. Darkvision, Chakra Sight, Tremor Sense etc.)

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they instead gain 2 ranks of Concussed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6 and the number of targets by +1.
